raw_transcription:
Static in the summer
Static in the summer
Traffic lights flicker, red to green
Like they're trying to tell me something
Every face becomes a blur
But somehow I still know this yours
The train rolls by, it has passed ten
The sound bends into your old anthem
And for a second you're alive
Walking right beside me
I don't know if I'm hearing ghosts
Or if my mind just won't let go
You're the static in the summer air
Every frequency says you're still there
In the home of the wires and the buzz of the bars
And the noise of a city that remembers
Who we are, you're the air
Going underneath the sound
The missing note that still hangs around everywhere
I go, I swear I almost know
How to leave you behind
Oh
Rain taps with us on the roof
Like a drummer trying to find you
Every random melody feels like it was written secretly
For the nights we thought would never end
For the version of us we couldn't defend
Now the years move on
There's something stays
Like a photograph that learns sing
Buried somewhere inside everything
Your stack in the summer air
Every frequency says you're still there
In the glow of the tree lights on the late night trains
And the space is between words and the silence
After the names you're the echo underneath the sound
The missing note that still hangs around everywhere
I go, I swear I almost know
How to leave you behind
Oh
Maybe it was never you at all
Maybe time just built a cathedral
How to sing is too small to keep
Maybe every memory becomes a radio signal
Looking for somewhere to sleep
Your stack in the summer air
Every frequency says you're still there
But tonight the signal's getting weak
The distance finally reaching me
You're the echo underneath the sound
But even it goes fade out now
The city keeps staying, the world keeps spinning
And for the first time I don't turn around
Just standing
Just standing
Just standing
In the summer air
